title: Clarify retry map schema, add stream-yielder adapters across Py/TS/Go, and minor SDK bumps
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: In customer rollouts we observed confusion around retry configuration naming (backoff vs retry_window vs retry_profile) across SDKs and slightly different defaults for stream consumers. This PR standardizes the human-facing retry map keys, introduces minimal adapter primitives ("stream-yielders") that make streaming ergonomics more consistent across Python/TypeScript/Go, and applies coordinated minor version bumps.

Summary of changes: Consolidate retry config keys to a small canonical set (mode, base_delay_ms, max_delay_ms, jitter, attempts). Map old aliases during legacy parsing to the canonical keys with warnings in debug logs. Add 'StreamYielder' adapters that provide a small ergonomic facade for consumers who prefer async-generator / async-iterator style consumption (Py: async generator helper; TS: async iterable wrapper; Go: channel-backed yielder). The adapters are intentionally lightweight — they do not change transport semantics or tokenization behavior.

Files touched (high level): redwood/sdk/python/retry.py, redwood/sdk/python/streaming/adapter.py, redwood/sdk/typescript/retry.ts, redwood/sdk/typescript/streamYielder.ts, redwood/sdk/go/retry.go, redwood/sdk/go/stream_yielder.go, docs/sdk/retry-migration.md, CHANGELOGs and package version files.

Migration notes:
- Existing code using previous aliases will continue to work; during initialization a debug-level deprecation log will indicate the canonical name to adopt.
- If you relied on implicit defaults (particularly older 'attempts' being infinite), we now default attempts to 6 for request streams and 3 for non-streaming calls; this is called out in docs and changelogs.

Testing: Unit tests added for mapping aliases, boundary backoff math, and a small end-to-end streaming smoke test in each SDK target. Manual validation performed by running the example chat/stream demo with local dev runtime and the benchmark-lab harness to ensure latency regressions are <1%.

Rollout: Feature flagged on server side for 48 hours, we will coordinate SDK releases (Py 1.11.2, TS 1.8.4, Go 1.5.1) after canary monitoring stabilizes.

Checklist: [x] docs updated, [x] unit tests, [x] e2e smoke, [x] changelogs bumped, [x] reviewers assigned.

release_notes: Standardize SDK retry configuration keys (mode, base_delay_ms, max_delay_ms, jitter, attempts). Introduce lightweight StreamYielder adapters to improve cross-language streaming ergonomics (Python async generator, TypeScript async iterable, Go channel yielder). Minor SDK version bumps: py 1.11.2, ts 1.8.4, go 1.5.1. Backwards-compatible alias mapping included; see docs/sdk/retry-migration.md for details.
notes_for_support: If customers report unexpected retry behavior after upgrade, confirm they are not relying on old implicit defaults; advise setting explicit attempts and base_delay_ms. For stream cancelation issues, ensure consumer uses provided yielder close/abort helpers (examples in docs).
post_merge_actions: Publish SDK packages after 48h canary; run rollback playbook if error rate increases >2% on canaries; monitor cost/latency dashboards for 72h.
